name: 358-toddle
notes: #358 B2.d toddle: a carer strolls a small circle (0.12 u/s) and a little one wobbles after it, 0.15 u behind, arms out, rolling side to side (View/Beats/KidPlay.cs ToddleGame). Every 6-10 s the toddler plops down (squash, a drop, Back); the carer stops, turns, bends to it, and on they go (the end beat). In the game babies are drawn on their carer (#192), so this shows through the cheat 'Toddle' (a kid as the toddler) until the user decides (open question).
